main.title: Organize Your Day Effectively
main.description: Plan, track, and accomplish more with our intuitive task management solution. Experience the future of productivity.

features.title: Discover Our Powerful Features
features.subtitle: Plan My Day offers a comprehensive set of tools to boost your productivity and streamline your workflow.

smartCalendar.title: Task Calendar
smartCalendar.description: Convenient calendar with task display and sorting capabilities.
smartCalendar.details: Our calendar allows you to view all tasks in a convenient format, sort them by priority, date, etc., and quickly add new tasks directly from the calendar.

taskManagement.title: Task Management
taskManagement.description: Complete set of features for creating, editing, deleting, and organizing tasks.
taskManagement.details: The task management system includes the ability to create detailed tasks with descriptions, set deadlines, priorities, track progress, and mark tasks as completed.

categoryManagement.title: Category Management
categoryManagement.description: Create, edit, and organize categories for effective task grouping.
categoryManagement.details: The category management feature allows you to create custom categories for grouping tasks, for better work organization.

teamCollaboration.title: Team Collaboration
teamCollaboration.description: Create projects and invite team members for collaborative work on tasks.
teamCollaboration.details: The team collaboration feature allows you to create projects, add participants, assign tasks to specific team members, and track the overall team progress.

smartNotifications.title: Notifications and Reminders
smartNotifications.description: Receive notifications about system actions and reminders about task deadlines.
smartNotifications.details: The notification system informs you about all important events: changes in tasks, approaching deadlines, comments from team members, and other important updates.

statistics.title: Performance Statistics
statistics.description: Analyze work efficiency with detailed task completion statistics.
statistics.details: The statistics feature provides detailed reports on completed tasks, productivity, deadline compliance, and other performance indicators to help optimize your workflow.
